items.title: Nvidia Responds to Gentlemen Ransomware Claim
items.summary: Nvidia says it has found no indication that its systems were compromised after the Gentlemen ransomware group listed the company as a victim. The post Nvidia Responds to Gentlemen Ransomware Claim appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: PHP Patches Seven Critical RCE Vulnerabilities

items.title: Five warning signs of ransomware breach before encryption or data theft
items.summary: Ransomware attacks often involve credential theft, lateral movement, and attempts to disable security controls long before encryption begins. Acronis examines five warning signs that can help defenders detect intrusions earlier, contain malicious activity, and protect critical systems and backups. [...]

items.summary: Two critical NGINX vulnerabilities dubbed "nginx2root" allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely on vulnerable web servers, with researchers demonstrating how the flaws can be chained with a Linux kernel bug to gain root access. [...]

items.title: Le strategie di Cina e Stati Uniti sull’intelligenza artificiale
items.summary: Potenza o efficienza? Mano libera o pianificazione? Modelli aperti o proprietari? Le due superpotenze stanno seguendo strade profondamente diverse nella corsa all’AI. A decretare il vincitore potrebbe però essere un altro elemento: chi riuscirà a sostenerne i costi.
